item.title: Version 1.8
item.description:
Recursive library scan progress

  • Added visible progress, processed counts, and the current nested filename while scanning.
  • Added cancellation plus completion, skipped-file, and failure feedback.
  • Kept the existing playlist available until a replacement scan completes successfully.

item.title: Version 1.7
item.description:
Sparkle installation bridge

  • Completed Sparkle's sandboxed installer configuration for future automatic updates.
  • Rotated the Sparkle update key and added a release-time key consistency check.
  • Documented Sentinel as a free first-install workaround for macOS quarantine.
  • This build is a one-time manual update; automatic updates resume after build 79 is installed.

item.title: Version 1.6
item.description:
New Features

  • Added Sparkle for automatic application updates.
  • Implemented a caching system for faster startup times.
  • Added a search bar to the playlist view.
  • Added a jump link for the currently playing song.
  • Added a menu bar to control music without switching to the app.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an issue where the default sort order was not applied on launch.
  • Loopback worked but the timeline was not moving.
